decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $15 price, $5 founder share, $5 affiliate share, $5 Small Block pool share, and removal of Big Block from active prize-pool destinations.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the Big Block FAQ attribute and rewrites affected ticket, funding, delivery, allocation, and revenue-split copy for the remaining Small Block mechanism.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the About-page process copy with Small Block-only ticket and prize language, so the source decision is already represented.
The existing same-message MODIFY updates the mission-page prize description to the remaining Small Block pool and its never-ending $500 prizes.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the affected ticket_draws list with SMALL_BLOCK only; no obsolete Big Block key remains.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes both Big Block ticket-issuance attributes while preserving the unaffected Small Block issuance rules.
The existing same-message MODIFY limits applicable_draws and scope contexts to the remaining Small Block draw while preserving the unchanged VRF selection behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter attribute and leaves the Small Block counter intact.
Removing Big Block does not change the generic automatic direct-wallet delivery mode for prizes from the remaining Small Block mechanism.
The Winners page, dashboard, and email notification channels remain valid unchanged for winners of the remaining Small Block prizes.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible attribute while preserving Small Block and badge metadata.
The requirement generically exposes current prize-pool values and remains valid for the remaining Small Block pool; it contains no Big Block-specific key requiring removal.
